outcome: immediate, early, and late complications of CS
cohort: The cohort consisted of 278 women undergoing their first Cesarean Section at Kafr Eldawar General Hospital between August 2023 and August 2024.
finding: The most common indications for first-time Cesarean Section were unknown causes (41.7%), decreased fetal movement (24.8%), and failed induction of labor (15.8%), with no significant associations found between parity or age and CS causes.
mod_finding: The study identified that the most common indications for first-time Cesarean Section were unknown causes, decreased fetal movement, and failed induction of labor, highlighting the need for improved clinical assessment and documentation to reduce unnecessary primary CS rates.
